title: The Frog Prince: A Timeless Bedtime Story for Kids Ages 3–10: A Beautifully Illustrated Picture Book Retelling of the Classic Fairy Tale (Classic Story Collection)
shortDescription: A charming picture book retelling of the classic Frog Prince fairy tale for children ages 3–10. With gentle storytelling, a golden ball, an enchanted frog, royal castle adventures, and warm vintage-inspired illustrations, this timeless story celebrates kindness, promises, and looking beyond appearances.
descriptionHtml:
A beautifully illustrated Picture Book featuring timeless, vintage-inspired artwork reminiscent of the classic storybooks generations of families have treasured. Every page captures the warmth, wonder, and nostalgic charm of traditional children's books, creating a magical reading experience to share again and again.

Step into the enchanted world of The Frog Prince, where a golden ball, an ancient well, a mysterious little frog, and a kind-hearted princess come together in a timeless story about promises, kindness, and discovering the beauty within.

This lovingly retold classic invites young readers on an unforgettable adventure filled with gentle magic, royal castles, loyal friendship, and a heartwarming lesson that has inspired children for generations.

Written in a warm, engaging style, this adaptation is perfect for children ages 3–10. The easy-to-follow storytelling preserves the charm of the original fairy tale while making it accessible for today's young readers, whether they're enjoying the story independently or sharing it during bedtime.

Follow the young princess as she searches for her precious golden ball, keeps an unexpected promise, and discovers that true kindness has the power to break even the oldest enchantment.

Rich, full-color illustrations in a nostalgic vintage storybook style bring every magical moment to life, making each page a delight to explore together. Watch for the mysterious enchantress whose spell changes everything—and whose lesson lingers long after the final page.

Perfect for:

• Bedtime reading • Read-aloud story time • Lovers of classic fairy tales • Preschool and elementary classrooms • Family reading time • Birthdays, holidays, and special gifts

Book Features

• Large 8.5 × 11 inch format • Gorgeous full-color illustrations on every page • Vintage-inspired artwork with the charm of classic storybooks • A gentle, child-friendly retelling of the timeless fairy tale • Easy-to-follow storytelling for children ages 3–10 • A short introduction to the history of the classic tale • A beautifully illustrated "Meet the Characters" section

Whether you're sharing The Frog Prince for the very first time or rediscovering a beloved childhood favorite, this beautifully illustrated keepsake Picture Book is one families will enjoy reading together for years to come.

Open the book, make a promise, follow the little frog to the ancient well, and let the magic of The Frog Prince become part of your family's bedtime tradition.
